content.text: In Zimbabwe, digital creators face a stark reality: global payment platforms like Stripe and PayPal are inaccessible. Your ability to sell digital products—ebooks, courses, templates—is crippled by infrastructure you cannot control. This is not a problem of workarounds but of sovereignty. COREMERCH’s Edge Commerce Stack deploys a Supabase-powered order database, Cloudflare Workers backend, and NOWPayments crypto processing. You own the infrastructure. No subscriptions. No platform lock-in. This is how you build a digital store that operates on your terms, not Silicon Valley’s.
Why This Infrastructure Works When Platforms Fail

Supabase, paired with Cloudflare Workers and NOWPayments, eliminates dependency on third-party platforms. Supabase acts as your order database—a PostgreSQL instance with built-in authentication and real-time updates. Cloudflare Workers handle backend logic, ensuring your store runs without servers you manage. NOWPayments processes crypto payments with a 0.5% fee, no KYC, and no buyer accounts required. This stack is sovereign: hosted on your GitHub or Cloudflare account, owned by you, and operational even when global platforms reject your currency or location. It is infrastructure you control, not rent.
What You Need Before You Deploy

To deploy the Edge Commerce Stack, you need a Cloudflare account (free), a Supabase project (free tier), and a NOWPayments API key. Register a domain or use a Cloudflare Pages subdomain. Prepare your digital products—upload them to Cloudflare R2 or Google Drive for delivery. Ensure your email is configured for order confirmations. No coding expertise required, but you must follow the deployment steps precisely. COREMERCH provides the blueprints, but you execute the deployment. This is not a managed service—it is ownership from day one.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

Start by configuring NOWPayments to accept payments in BSC, Solana, or TRON for low fees. Set up webhooks to trigger order fulfillment in Cloudflare Workers. In Supabase, create tables for orders, products, and customers. Link Cloudflare Workers to Supabase for real-time order storage. For delivery, integrate Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 to serve files securely. Test the pipeline with a testnet transaction before going live. Every component is modular—you can replace or upgrade parts without rebuilding the entire stack.
Supabase is your database—not a platform’s. You own the data, period.
Going Live and Processing Your First Transaction

Testing before promotion is not optional — it is the step that determines whether your store functions correctly under real conditions before real buyers encounter it. The test sequence has four steps. First: deploy the backend — Cloudflare Worker or Apps Script Web App — and confirm the webhook endpoint returns a valid response to a test HTTP POST. Second: configure the storefront and confirm the checkout displays correctly on desktop and mobile, QR codes generate, and live price feeds load. Third: complete a real mainnet transaction with a small amount of actual crypto — send real USDT or BTC to your configured wallet address and confirm in your NOWPayments dashboard that the transaction was detected and the webhook was fired. Fourth: check your order database — Supabase or Google Sheets — and confirm the order was logged correctly, the delivery email arrived, and the download link works. Only after all four steps confirm should you share the store URL publicly.
Scaling Once the Infrastructure Is Running

With the Edge Commerce Stack live, scale by adding products to Supabase, optimizing Cloudflare Workers for higher traffic, or integrating additional payment networks via NOWPayments. Use Supabase’s real-time capabilities to build customer dashboards or analytics. The stack is designed for growth—no bottlenecks, no platform limits. You control the pace and direction of expansion. This is not a temporary solution—it is your permanent commerce infrastructure.
